title: Former Austin Freight Systems controller pleads guilty in $3.2M embezzlement scheme
content:

The FBI investigated the case, and company officials say they have strengthened financial processes while continuing normal operations.

title: Fatal accident dockside shuts operations at JNPA box terminal
content:
Operations at Nhava Sheva Freeport Terminal  in India’s JNPA harbour halted this morning following an accident that left one docker dead and two others seriously injured.
